profile.headline: Developer, Solutions Architect, Team Leader | Developing teams and technical solutions across the higher ed and digital consulting landscape | Acquia-certified Drupal developer
profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Dave, a web developer, people manager, copywriter, and author.  In my former life I worked in the clinical & counseling space before pivoting into tech, where I have spent the last 12 years developing efficient web solutions.

Now my time is spent building teams and architecting technical solutions. I’ve worked with companies across the nonprofit, higher education, healthcare, and financial service industries, both in-house and as a consultant.  My strengths include leadership, stakeholder management, process improvement initiatives and documentation.

In my most recent roles, Drupal has been my primary technical focus, but my full toolkit includes HTML5, CSS3, React, Vue.js, PHP, MySQL, and WordPress.

I love tech, but my passion has always been leadership. I’ve gained invaluable skills in people management through my time in the clinical space. Mentoring other developers and helping them to be successful in their careers has been the most rewarding part of my own career.

I’m always open to connecting with like-minded professionals for potential collaboration.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: My role at the Museum of Science was eliminated due to a workforce reduction. I was part of a small, agile team of developers responsible for maintaining multiple web properties. We architected and implemented new features based on stakeholder requirements, and maintained existing web properties. My specific responsibilities include full-stack development in Drupal, devops, release management, and e-commerce development. I was the front-end lead for a major e-commerce re-platform.

positions.title: Director of Web Development
positions.description:
My position with the University of Alabama at Birmingham was eliminated when they unfortunately halted the project I was hired to manage due to lack of funding.  UAB was in the process of re-platforming 300+ websites from Joomla into Drupal, so I was brought on given my expertise in Drupal. 
 
We utilized Acquia’s Site Factory platform, and I was responsible for building the application foundation.  This included headcount & operational planning encompassing systems analysis, project timelines, vendor relationships, and planning integrations with external systems.  

Additionally, I oversaw and planned the $750k+ hiring budget for the project along with designing the overall build approach.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS Flexbox · Drupal · Remote Team Management · Vue.js · DevOps · Tailwind CSS · Linux · JavaScript · Director level · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)

positions.title: Senior Web Engineer
positions.description: At Urban Insight, I functioned in the capacity of full-stack developer and front-end lead for specific Drupal projects in the nonprofit sector. This included a site with a theme that varied based on micro-sites within the primary site.
positions.insights: Skills: Drupal · Tailwind CSS · AlpineJS · SASS · JavaScript · PHP

positions.title: Technical Architect and Manager
positions.description:
Perficient is a digital transformation consulting firm. I was unfortunately laid off due to cost cutting initiatives, along with many others in my unit.
   
I originally spent four years working with MedTouch, until Perficient acquired MedTouch in 2020. 

I architected and documented end-to-end Drupal and WordPress solutions for enterprise clients across a variety of industries including healthcare, financial services, infrastructure and utilities. I led teams of 5-8 developers and interfaced with clients on projects lasting 12+ months.   
 
I directly managed and mentored a team of 5 developers including direct work oversight, evaluations, and development.  

My role entailed establishing, articulating, and implementing best practices for Drupal and front-end development.

positions.title: Technical Lead and Development Team Manager
positions.description:
My prior role with MedTouch was twofold.  I oversaw a team of 5 UI developers (including work oversight, development, and annual evaluations) while also leading the launch and scale of a new Drupal division from the ground up.

This new division allowed us to facilitate Drupal solution adoption for our clients.   I was responsible for the hiring, interviewing, and onboarding while also establishing best practices for development operations and workflow.   We grew into a team of 3, plus third party contractors, to deliver projects on time for our healthcare clients.
 
I maintained 80% retention for my team of 5 UI developers prior to the Perficient acquisition.

positions.title: Senior User Interface Developer
positions.description: I led front-end development for sites and applications in the healthcare sector using modern CSS, Sass, Grunt, Gulp, Webpack and Vue.js, and led full-stack development utilizing Drupal.

I also designed internal graphics and print collateral for both external and internal campaigns.
